name: One Last Chance
source:
A romantic and endearing story in the style of “romance movie greats” like Nancy Meyer and Richard Linklater set in Martha’s Vineyard, Massachusetts. 

Do you remember that high school crush you never confessed your love to? 

Do you ever wonder what could have been if things had gone different back then? 

This Visual Novel/Dating Sim explores those questions that we constantly ask ourselves. It’s about star crossed lovers, missed opportunities and taking chances to find true and ever lasting love.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/460150]Steam[/url]]
